_comment: Configurable weights and severities (spec: not hard-coded). ASSUMPTION documented in ARCHITECTURE.md: TIME=MAJOR (the two user specs disagree: CRITICAL in one, MODERATE in an example of the other).
_irreversible_actions_comment: E-MCP/E-AUTONOMOUS (2026-09-30): a NARROWER list than destructive_actions, used only by aixl/negotiation.py to decide whether an actions-dimension disagreement must escalate to REJECT instead of being auto-resolved by trusting the sender. destructive_actions (used for compare's own CRITICAL severity display) includes UPDATE/SEND/DISABLE/EXECUTE, which are common and usually reversible — reusing that list here broke the real 'Close ticket' vs 'Delete ticket' case (UPDATE is on both sides of countless ordinary disagreements). Real evidence (3 tested pairs: Close/Delete, Archive/Delete, Send/Delete) only ever involved DELETE as the irreversible side; the other action was always something reversible. Scoped to DELETE alone until further evidence justifies widening it.
_action_groups_comment: ASSUMPTION (added after blind run 1): actions in the same group are treated as the same task for equivalence; the first item is the representative. Blind authors treated Crea/Escribe, Fetch/Get, Busca/Localiza, Verifica/Valida as the same instruction. Configurable: set to [] for strict lexical actions.
